name: @huranth/gama-harness
description: Coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:unbundled && node ../../scripts/build-coding-agent-bundle.mjs
scripts.build:unbundled: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:binary: npm --prefix ../tui run build && npm --prefix ../telemetry run build && npm --prefix ../ai run build && npm --prefix ../agent run build && npm run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-bunfig ./dist/bun/cli.js ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts ./src/ext/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/gama && npm run copy-binary-assets
scripts.copy-assets: shx mkdir -p dist/modes/tui/theme && shx cp src/modes/tui/theme/*.json dist/modes/tui/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/core/html/vendor && shx cp src/core/html/template.html src/core/html/template.css src/core/html/template.js dist/core/html/ && shx cp src/core/html/vendor/*.js dist/core/html/vendor/
scripts.copy-binary-assets: shx cp package.json dist/ && shx mkdir -p dist/theme && shx cp src/modes/tui/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && shx mkdir -p dist/html/vendor && shx cp src/core/html/template.html dist/html/ && shx cp src/core/html/vendor/*.js dist/html/vendor/ && shx cp -r examples dist/ && shx cp ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: huranth
